description: JVM classes and nominal checks slice (ISSUE-0095). Fixtures that run the real DEAL frontend (lexer → parser → name resolver → type checker) → real JvmBackend codegen → javac subprocess → java subprocess executing the emitted artifact (the harness fails a fixture whose codegen or JVM execution is bypassed); every fixture is JVM-only except the write-order parity pin, which also runs under real luajit. Covered forms: local class declarations with defaulted primitive fields, object-literal class construction (defaults applied per construction, provided fields in literal evaluation order, construction before the class declaration — checker hoisting), primitive field reads and writes (int/number/boolean/string), fresh instances per construction, module-level (load-time) construction, class-field default expressions (arithmetic defaults, defaults containing null-typed calls, and nil-aware boolean defaults failing the typed boolean boundary with E8001 — parity with the identifier boundary), the boolean construction-value boundary (a nil-aware &&/|| provided value raises E8001 — never a bare unboxing NPE — while the in-bounds positive control constructs normally), the same-module nominal runtime checks at the slice's one untyped boundary (a table field read in a class-typed contextual target — success for a genuine instance, E8001 for a plain table value, for a null value, and for an identically-shaped sibling class, pinning nominal — never structural — identity), and class-field write evaluation order (a cross-backend parity pin: getBox().x = make(note("value")) prints target → value → make under both real luajit and the emitted JVM artifact — spec v1.2 §Operational semantics rule 1 evaluates the receiver before the RHS, pinning the pre-fix JVM inversion — and a JVM-only error-precedence pin: the receiver getP() still prints target before the RHS's nil-aware xs[0] && xs[5] crosses the write's typed boolean boundary with E8001), and one frontend compile-error gate rejected before any backend runs (E3001 nominal A→B assignment). Spec v1.2 classes are sealed records with no methods and no constructors, so the method surface is empty: the only callables are the module functions the earlier function-slice fixtures cover (methods where supported = none, documented in the review evidence).

tests.name: jvm-class-field-read-write
tests.description: Declared primitive class fields are readable and writable: p.x and p.y are read, mutated, and read back (1+5=6, 2+2=4 → 64)

tests.name: jvm-class-primitive-field-types
tests.description: All four primitive field types flow through construction and reads: int, number, boolean, and string fields keep their provided values

tests.name: jvm-class-construction-evaluation-order
tests.description: Provided field values evaluate left-to-right in literal order even when the literal order differs from the field declaration order: tag(second) prints before tag(first), and each value still lands in its declared field

tests.name: jvm-class-nominal-check-failure-table
tests.description: A plain table value crossing the class-typed boundary fails the runtime nominal check with E8001 (expected class instance) — never a silent cast

tests.name: jvm-class-nominal-check-failure-null
tests.description: A null value crossing the class-typed boundary fails the runtime nominal check with E8001 (expected class instance)

tests.name: jvm-class-same-shape-nominal-failure
tests.description: Identically-shaped sibling classes stay nominally distinct at runtime: an A instance crossing a B-typed boundary fails with E8001 (expected instance of B, got A) — identity is nominal, never structural

tests.name: jvm-class-bool-construction-value-boundary
tests.description: A provided construction value whose emitted code can be the Lua nil (a nil-aware && over boolean[] reads) fails the constructor's typed boolean boundary with E8001 — never a bare unboxing NullPointerException (parity with the identifier boundary `let b: boolean = xs[0] && xs[5]`)

tests.name: jvm-class-default-expression-arithmetic
tests.description: Class-field default expressions are fully type-checked: an ordinary arithmetic default (`x: int = 1 + 2`) constructs and runs (the pre-fix backend rejected the same program with a spurious E6000 'ADD on error and error' while LuaJIT compiles and runs it)

tests.name: jvm-class-default-null-typed-call
tests.description: A default expression containing a null-typed call (`wrap(noise())`) hoists the call into a pre-statement and passes the null argument — the emitted artifact is valid Java (the pre-fix backend emitted `new $C_P(wrap(noise()))` and javac rejected it with "'void' type not allowed here" after the CLI reported success)

tests.name: jvm-class-field-write-eval-order-parity
tests.description: Cross-backend parity for class field write evaluation order with a side-effecting receiver and a hoisting RHS: spec v1.2 §Operational semantics rule 1 evaluates the receiver before member/index/call arguments, so getBox() prints 'target', the RHS's hoisted null-typed call prints 'value', then make prints 'make' — target, value, make under both real luajit and the emitted JVM artifact (the pre-fix JVM flushed the RHS's hoisted print before the whole assignment statement: value, target, make)

tests.name: jvm-class-field-write-error-precedence
tests.description: JVM-only pin for error precedence in a class field write: the receiver evaluates first (spec v1.2 §Operational semantics rule 1), so getP() prints 'target' before the RHS's nil-aware && over a past-end boolean[] read crosses the write's typed boolean boundary and raises E8001 — target then DEAL_ERROR_CODE: E8001, exit 1 (the pre-fix JVM ran the RHS's hoisted boxed reads first and raised E8001 without printing 'target')
